title: Calculate Moles
text: n(H2) = 5g / 2 g/mol = 2.5 mol. n(O2) = 20g / 32 g/mol = 0.625 mol

title: Use Mole Ratio
text: 2H2 + O2 -> 2H2O. Ratio H2:O2 = 2:1. For 2.5 mol H2, we need 2.5/2 = 1.25 mol O2

title: Identify Limiting Reagent
text: We need 1.25 mol O2 but only have 0.625 mol. Oxygen is the limiting reagent.
